# Chronology Of Shares Listing

Kronologi Pencatatan Saham

The Company has submitted a Registration Statement in connection with the Public Offering to the Financial Services Authority under Number 396/SGH-OJK/VI/2020 dated June 25, 2020 regarding the Cover Letter for the Registration Statement in the context of the Company's Initial Public Offering and the latest amendments and/or additional information had been submitted through Letter Number 529/SGH-OJK/VIII/2020 dated August 28, 2020 regarding the Cover Letter for Changes and/or Additional Documents and/or Information on the Registration Statement in the context of the Company's Initial Public Offering in accordance with the requirements stipulated in the Law No. 8 of 1995 concerning the Capital Market, which is contained in the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 64 of 1995, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia No. 3608 and its implementing regulations ("UUPM") and their amendments include OJK Regulation No. 7/POJK.04/2017 concerning Registration Statement Documents for Public Offering of Equity Securities, Debt Securities, and/or Sukuk.

The Company officially conducted an Initial Public Offering (IPO) on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on September 8, 2020 and became the 42nd issuer in 2020 or the 705th of the total issuers. The Company has set an offering price of IDR1,820 per share and has gone through a public offering process on 2 - 3 September 2020. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas has been appointed as the Underwriter in the Company's Initial Public Offering. The number of shares offered to public at that time was 114,380,700 shares or 13.78% of the total issued and paid-up capital of the Company after the Company's Initial Public Offering.

Perseroan telah menyampaikan Pernyataan Pendaftaran sehubungan dengan Penawaran Umum kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan dengan Nomor 396/SGH-OJK/VI/2020 tanggal 25 Juni 2020 perihal Surat Pengantar untuk Pernyataan Pendaftaran dalam rangka Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan dan perubahan dan/atau tambahan informasi yang terakhir disampaikan melalui Surat Nomor 529/SGH-OJK/VIII/2020 tanggal 28 Agustus 2020 perihal Surat Pengantar untuk Perubahan dan/atau Tambahan Dokumen dan/atau Informasi atas Pernyataan Pendaftaran dalam rangka Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan sesuai dengan persyaratan yang ditetapkan dalam Undang-Undang No. 8 Tahun 1995 tentang Pasar Modal, yang dimuat dalam Lembaran Negara Republik Indonesia No. 64 Tahun 1995, Tambahan Lembaran Negara Republik Indonesia No. 3608 dan peraturan pelaksanaannya ("UUPM") serta perubahan-perubahannya antara lain Peraturan OJK No. 7/POJK.04/2017 tentang Dokumen Pernyataan Pendaftaran Dalam Rangka Penawaran Umum Efek Bersifat Ekuitas, Efek Bersifat Utang, dan/atau Sukuk.

Perseroan melakukan Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham (IPO) secara resmi di Bursa Efek Indonesia pada tanggal 8 September 2020 dan menjadi emiten ke-42 di tahun 2020 atau ke-705 dari total emiten. Perseroan telah menetapkan harga penawaran Rp1.820 per saham dan telah melalui proses penawaran umum pada 2 - 3 September 2020. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas telah ditunjuk sebagai Penjamin Emisi Efek dalam Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan. Jumlah saham yang ditawarkan kepada masyarakat pada saat itu adalah 114.380.700 lembar saham atau 13,78% dari total modal ditempatkan dan disetor Perseroan setelah pelaksanaan Penawaran Umum Perdana Saham Perseroan.

# Building for the Future

Membangun untuk Masa Depan

## Record performance during the pandemic – foundation laid for future growth.

Kinerja luar biasa kami selama pandemi – menjadi fondasi untuk pertumbuhan kami di masa mendatang.

## Dear valued Shareholders

Pemegang Saham yang Terhormat,

The world in 2020/21 was firmly in the grip of the coronavirus pandemic. Across the globe many people died from the virus infection, the economy slumped, livelihoods were destroyed. For SOHO Global Health, too, it was a challenging period, yet we came through the pandemic in good shape and at the same time laid the foundation for future growth.

We achieved a great deal in the face of volatile conditions, bringing new products to market for our customers and patients, driving forward SOHO's transformation and taking our sustainability commitment to the next level. We invested substantially in innovation and future growth.

## Shouldering responsibility during the crisis

Looking back to the past year, we have much we can be proud of. We managed to keep the company running successfully despite this major crisis, and continued providing patients and consumers with urgently needed and, in some cases, life-saving products. Our Imboost Force was the most sought after health supplement during the various pandemic waves. At the same time we succeeded in protecting our workforce and minimizing the number of Covid-19 infections in the company, although, sadly, several colleagues passed away due to the severe delta variant that hit Indonesia in the middle of the year.

We would like to recognize in particular our frontline employees and factory workers – their hard work and resilience were critical to get through 2021 and to maintain business continuity. Our businesses in healthcare and distribution are all essential to people's lives and it is our social responsibility to ensure stable production and supply.

This effort wasn't primarily driven by financial considerations. Our overriding aim has been to contribute to ending the pandemic. Right from the start of this emergency, we've been helping in many ways: we donated money, medicines, multivitamins, protective equipment and medical appliances either through government agencies and charity foundations or directly to medical personnel and people in need. On top of that, we've helped raising awareness and providing relevant health information via a series of webinars with experts/Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

Sepanjang tahun 2022/21 dunia telah berada dalam cengkraman pandemi coronavirus. Di seluruh dunia banyak orang meninggal dikarenakan terinfeksi virus, kondisi perkonomian terpuruk, bahkan mata pencaharian hancur. Bagi SOHO Global Health juga demikian, masa-masa itu sungguh penuh tantangan, namun kami berhasil melalui pandemi dengan kinerja yang luar biasa dan disaat yang bersamaan membangun fondasi untuk membangun pertumbuhan kami di

Kami berhasil meraih banyak pencapaian ditengah situasi yang tidak menentu, meluncurkan produk baru bagi pelanggan dan pasien, menggawangi transformasi SOHO dan komitmen berkelanjutan ke tahap berikutnya. Kami melakukan investasi yang substansial pada inovasi dan pertumbuhan.

## Memikul tanggung jawab selama krisis

Melihat kembali ke tahun sebelumnya, kami memiliki banyak hal untuk dibanggakan. Kami mengelola perusahaan agar tetap berjalan dengan sukses ditengah krisis, dan terus melayani pasien dan pelanggan dengan kebutuhan mendesak, bahkan dalam kondisi tertentu, kebutuhan akan produk life-saving. Imboost Force merupakan salah satu produk suplemen kesehatan paling dicari konsumen selama beberapa kali gelombang pandemi. Di saat bersamaan kami berhasil melindungi kesehatan tenaga kerja kami dan meminimalkan paparan infeksi Covid-19 di perusahaan kami, walaupun dengan sangat berduka, kami kehilangan beberapa kolega yang meninggal dunia akibat parahnya infeksi varian delta di Indonesia pada pertengahan tahun lalu.

Kami hendak memberikan penghormatan secara khusus pada karyawan yang berada di garis depan dan para pekerja pabrik – kerja keras dan resiliensi mereka penting untuk keberhasilan kami melalui 2021 dan menjaga keberlangsungan usaha. Kegiatan bisnis kami di bidang kesehatan dan distribusi adalah esensial untuk kehidupan banyak orang dan adalah tanggung jawab sosial kami untuk memastikan stabilitas produksi dan pasokan produk kesehatan.

Segala upaya yang kami lakukan tidak semata-mata berdasarkan pertimbangan finansial. Tujuan utama kami adalah berkontribusi untuk mengakhiri pandemi. # A Clear Digital Path Forward

Digital is transforming every aspect of our business at SOHO Global Health – from the way we innovate and develop medicines/health supplements, to the way we improve health outcomes and the way we do our work faster. We are simplifying and automating transactional processes to make room for more added value activities and to unleash the potential of our people.

Even before the pandemic started and disrupted the old ways of working, our digital transformation journey was well under way. Our key initiatives have been focused on the sales and marketing area: in 2018 we automated the ordering and sales force management processes introducing iMAP (Intelligent Mobile Automation Platform) both for our medreps and our distribution salesmen; in 2019 we introduced PPGOS (PPG Online System), a B2B e-commerce platform that allows outlets to order directly without the need for a salesman's visit. First launched in August 2019, PPGOS at the end of December 2021 already served 11.5% of PPG's total orders. In April 2021, the 2.0 version of PPGOS was released with a new user interface for a better customer's experience.

In addition we have established SGH's fast growing B2C e-commerce presence in a number of popular online marketplaces.

During 2020/21 when the business environment was hardly hit by the global pandemic and physical store footfall fell dramatically, our B2B and B2C e-commerce presence helped to provide our customers with safety and convenience to access our products.

We have set the bar high and have very high expectations for both PPG and the Group in the digital space over the next five years, with the objective to become among the top innovative healthcare companies with a formidable digital platform.

SOHO Global Health colleagues are staying ahead of the curve, leveraging the best of digital, data, and technology to power science and innovation.

Digital mengubah setiap aspek bisnis kami di SOHO Global Health – mulai dari cara kami berinovasi dan mengembangkan obat-obatan/suplemen kesehatan, hingga cara kami meningkatkan terapi kesehatan dan cara kami melakukan pekerjaan lebih cepat. Kami menyederhanakan dan mengotomatisasi proses transaksional untuk memberikan ruang bagi lebih banyak aktivitas nilai tambah dan untuk mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan potensi karyawan kami.

Bahkan sebelum pandemi dimulai dan mendisrupsi cara kerja lama, perjalanan transformasi digital kami sudah dimulai. Inisiatif utama kami difokuskan pada area penjualan dan pemasaran: pada tahun 2018 kami mengotomatiskan proses pemesanan dan manajemen sales force dengan memperkenalkan iMAP (Intelligent Mobile Automation Platform) baik untuk medreps maupun salesman distribusi kami; pada tahun 2019 kami meluncurkan layanan inovatif PPGOS (PPG Online System), platform B2B e-commerce yang memungkinkan outlet untuk memesan langsung tanpa perlu kunjungan salesman. PPGOS pertama kali diluncurkan pada Agustus 2019, dan pada akhir Desember 2021 sudah melayani 11,5% dari total order PPG. Pada April 2021, PPGOS versi 2.0 dirilis dengan new user interface untuk pengalaman pelanggan yang lebih baik.

Selain itu, kami juga telah memperkuat B2C e-commerce SGH yang berkembang pesat di sejumlah marketplace.

Selama tahun 2020/21 ketika keseluruhan bisnis terpukul dampak pandemi global dan kunjungan konsumen ke gerai-gerai ritel mengalami penurunan drastis, kehadiran B2B dan B2C e-commerce kami telah membantu memberikan keamanan dan kenyamanan kepada pelanggan untuk.

Kami telah menetapkan standar yang tinggi dan memiliki harapan yang sangat tinggi untuk SGH di ranah digital selama lima tahun ke depan, dengan tujuan untuk menjadi salah satu perusahaan penyedia kesehatan inovatif teratas dengan platform digital yang andal.

Rekan-rekan SOHO Global Health terus menjadi yang terdepan, memanfaatkan yang terbaik dari digital, data, dan teknologi untuk memperkuat ilmu pengetahuan dan inovasi.

# Tata Kelola Perusahaan dan Tanggung Jawab Perusahaan

Sebagai perusahaan yang bertanggung jawab, SOHO Global Health secara konsisten mendukung pengembangan masyarakat, penerapan praktik ketenagakerjaan yang adil, pelaksanaan operasi yang ramah lingkungan dan perlindungan kepentingan semua pelanggan. Ini adalah cara kami untuk menyeimbangkan tujuan bisnis Perseroan dengan tanggung jawab sosial dan lingkungan.

Sekilas Tentang SGH

# Our Business

SOHO Global Health is a leading healthcare company with a more than 70-year history and core competencies in the areas of natural/herbal health care products and services. Our more than 30 group brands range from best seller body defense brands like Imboost to leading kids multivitamin brands like Curcuma Plus and Fitkom. Guided by our corporate purpose "We hold the care of human life as our highest priority," we help to prevent and treat diseases, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the well-being of the community. Today we are creating a leading national enterprise built on strong brands and innovative ways of doing business.

SOHO has built a solid portfolio of market leading products. Topping the league table is Imboost, one of the fastest growing brands in the Indonesia healthcare market. Curcuma Plus and Diapet make the top three household brands, delivering nutrition and wellness to the community. With a clear focus on actively managing the portfolio and a deep pipeline of new products to sustain growth, SOHO is well-positioned to thrive.

We aim to bolster profitability and create value for our customers, shareholders and employees. Among healthcare professionals, patients and customers, the SOHO Global Health brands stand for trust, reliability and quality. Across our various businesses, our activities are guided by our corporate values of Absolute Integrity, Mutual Respect, Passion for Innovation and Culture of Discipline.

SOHO Global Health offers a unique and best-in-class platform in branding, sales & marketing, manufacturing and distribution to support future growth in the Indonesian market. Supported by over 2500 employees, SGH maintains coverage of ~90% of the targeted doctors, while distribution reaches 95% of hospitals and over 41,000 outlets nationwide.

# Bisnis Kami

SOHO Global Health adalah perusahaan terkemuka di bidang kesehatan yang memiliki sejarah lebih dari 70 tahun dan kompetensi inti di bidang layanan kesehatan dan produk natural/herbal. Lebih dari 30 merek grup kami berkisar dari suplemen untuk menjaga daya tahan tubuh terlaris seperti Imboost hingga merek multivitamin anak terkemuka seperti Curcuma Plus dan Fitkom. Dipandu oleh tujuan perusahaan kami, "Menjunjung kepedulian terhadap kehidupan manusia sebagai prioritas kami yang tertinggi," kami membantu mencegah dan mengobati penyakit, mempromosikan gaya hidup sehat dan kesejahteraan masyarakat. Hingga kini kami telah membangun perusahaan nasional terkemuka yang dibangun diatas merek yang kuat dan proses bisnis yang inovatif.

SOHO telah membangun portofolio produk unggulan yang solid. Diantaranya yang paling top adalah Imboost, salah satu brand dengan pertumbuhan tercepat di pasar perawatan kesehatan Indonesia. Curcuma Plus dan Diapet melengkapi top 3 produk unggulan di portofolio produk kami, menghadirkan produk bernutrisi dan menyehatkan bagi masyarakat. Dengan fokus yang jelas pada pengelolaan portofolio secara aktif dan rangkaian produk baru yang lengkap untuk melanjutkan pertumbuhan, SOHO berada di jalur yang tepat untuk terus berkembang.

Kami mempunyai tujuan untuk meningkatkan profitabilitas dan menciptakan nilai bagi pelanggan, pemegang saham, dan karyawan kami. Di antara profesional kesehatan, pasien, dan pelanggan, merek-merek produk SOHO Global Health merupakan jaminan keandalan dan kualitas. Di berbagai lini bisnis kami, kegiatan kami dipandu oleh nilai-nilai yang mengakar kuat yaitu Integritas Mutlak, Saling Menghormati, Semangat untuk Berinovasi dan Budaya Disiplin.

SOHO Global Health menawarkan platform unik dan terbaik di kelasnya dalam branding, penjualan & pemasaran, manufaktur, dan distribusi untuk mendukung pertumbuhan pasar Indonesia di masa mendatang. Didukung lebih dari 2500 karyawan, SGH mempertahankan coverage ~90% dari dokter yang ditargetkan, sementara distribusi menjangkau sekitar 95% dari total Rumah Sakit dan lebih dari 41.000 outlet secara nasional.

# Operational Area

## PROFESSIONAL PRODUCTS (PP)

Our Professional Products Division, carries a comprehensive range of products from unbranded generics to branded generics and licensed drugs.

At Professional Products Division, we focus on researching, developing and marketing specialty-focused innovative medicines that provide significant clinical benefit and value, primarily in the therapeutic areas of immunomodulator, respiratory, inflammation, and liver diseases.

This Division comprising scalable medical representatives and highly committed to implement compliant practices in the sales and promotion of our Prescriptions products, strictly following international standards.

Some other SGH Professional Product's top products include Asthin, Curvit, Curcuma Group, Oste Forte, Noroid and Prospan.

## CONSUMER HEALTH (CH)

Our Consumer Health division is bringing consumer-centric innovation with its mainly non-prescription (OTC) brand products to treat and prevent diseases and to improve well-being, providing consumers with the corresponding self-care solutions.

Its product portfolio spans from over-the-counter (OTC) drugs with therapeutic benefit to consumer products with health benefits. These products are well recognized and leading in their respective product categories.

Our Consumer Health business includes a portfolio of brands that aim to deliver consistent, high quality, and responsible growth supported by important investments in marketing and innovation. Our development strategies are focused on expanding and enhancing our brand portfolio. We aim to achieve this by developing new products along with new delivery forms, formulations, consumer messages, novel packaging forms and other innovations.

Some of SGH Consumer Health's top products include Imboost, Curcuma Plus, Fitkom, Diapet, Laxing and Lelap.

# Area Operasional

# Seed to Patient

As natural products are at the core of our product offering, we follow a "seed to patient" approach with respect to curcuma, a key ingredient in our Curcuma Group products. Natural medicines can vary considerably depending on how they are produced. Seed to Patient is a method where all of the processes involved in growing and manufacturing natural medicine are tightly controlled to reduce variability. This model is a holistic approach to research focused on each stage of the entire end-to-end product cycle. The process starts with a scientific approach for selecting standardized seeds from superior varieties of curcuma, which helps ensure a controlled and consistent process and product. We then work to innovate at each stage of the natural pharmaceutical value chain.

As part of our innovation process in herbal research, we are working to expand this approach to other ingredients, such as Echinacea, the key ingredient in our best selling product, Imboost.

Dikarenakan produk herbal merupakan inti dari produk - produk yang ditawarkan, Grup SGH menerapkan konsep "Seed to Patient" untuk temulawak, yang merupakan bahan inti dari produk Grup Curcuma. Kualitas obat-obatan herbal dapat bervariasi tergantung pada bagaimana cara memproduksi. Seed to Patient adalah metode di mana semua proses yang terlibat dalam pembudidayaan dan proses produksi obat herbal dikontrol ketat untuk mengurangi variabilitas ini. Konsep ini merupakan pendekatan holistik untuk penelitian yang berfokus pada setiap tahapan siklus produk dari hulu ke hilir. Proses "Seed to Patient" dimulai dengan pendekatan ilmiah dalam memilih benih standar dari varietas unggulan temulawak, yang membantu untuk memastikan proses dan produk yang terkendali dan konsisten. Grup SGH selanjutnya berupaya untuk melakukan innovasi pada setiap tahapan rantai nilai alami.

Sebagai bukti keseriusan kami dalam menghadirkan inovasi produk berbahan herbal, Grup SGH saat ini sedang berusaha untuk menerapkan proses ini ke bahan-bahan dasar lainnya seperti Echinacea yang merupakan bahan dasar utama produk best-seller kami, Imboost.

# Significant Changes

Throughout year 2021, there were several significant changes in the Company's shares ownership, in which all changes in the Company's share ownership have been reported by the Company and related shareholders, to the Financial Services Authority ("OJK") in accordance with the provisions of OJK and Indonesia Stock Exchange regulations. The changes in the Company's share ownership are as follows:

- Sale of all shares owned by Eng Liang Tan, as the President Commissioner of the Company and the party who own shares of 5% or more of the paid-up shares in the Company, namely 487,080,805 shares on the transaction date of January 14, 2021, with the aim of internal restructuring of his share ownership. On the same date, namely January 14, 2021, Tiberias 96 Pty Ltd has reported to the OJK that Tiberias 96 Pty Ltd has owned 481,237,031 shares of the Company. The sale of shares and these changes in ownership of the Company's shares did not result in a change of control over the Company because Tiberias 96 Pty Ltd is a company wholly owned (100%) by Eng Lian Tan.

- Sale of all shares of the Company which are directly owned by the Board of Directors of the Company, namely:

(i) Rogelio Paulino Jr. Castillo La O, as the President Director of the Company, has sold all of his shares amounting to 12,542,100 shares on the transaction date of May 19, 2021;

(ii) Piero Brambati, as the Director of the Company, has sold all of his shares amounting to 9,964,000 shares on the transaction date of May 19, 2021;

(iii) Yuliana, as Director of the Company, has sold all of her shares amounting to 6,327,000 shares on the transaction date of May 19, 2021; and

(iv) Henryk Klakurka as Director of the Company, has sold all of his shares amounting to 4,459,400 shares on the transaction date of May 19, 2021.

- Purchase of the Company's shares by Medisia Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd, as the shareholder who owns more than 5% of the Company's shares, a total of 51,651,300 of the Company's shares on the transaction date of May 19, 2021.

Human Capital

Sumber Daya Manusia

Human Resources at SOHO are centrally managed for all entities. In 2021, the educational background most frequent among the employees is senior high school, followed by bachelor degree.

Pengelolaan sumber daya manusia di SOHO dilakukan secara terpusat untuk seluruh entitas Perseroan. Di tahun 2021, jumlah karyawan terbanyak memiliki latar belakang pendidikan setingkat SLTA/sederajat, dan diikuti dengan karyawan berlatar belakang pendidikan Sarjana.

![img-64.jpeg](img-64.jpeg)

The Company does not employ minors, as stipulated in the Collective Labor Agreement and Company Regulations, one of the general requirements to be accepted as an employee is to be at least 18 (eighteen) years old at the time of admission.

When viewed by age, the largest group is within the range from 26 to 35 years and followed by the employees within the range from 36 to 45 years.

Perseroan tidak mempekerjakan anak di bawah umur, sebagaimana diatur di dalam Perjanjian Kerja Bersama dan Peraturan Perusahaan, salah satu persyaratan umum untuk diterima menjadi Karyawan adalah berusia minimal 18 (delapan belas) tahun pada saat penerimaan.

Jika dilihat dari usia, kelompok terbesar berada pada rentang usia 26 s/d 35 tahun dan diikuti dengan karyawan pada kelompok usia 36 s/d 45 tahun.

## OUR PURPOSE

Tujuan Kami

We have a simple but clear purpose – TO HOLD THE CARE OF HUMAN LIFE AS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY.

## OUR VISION

Visi Kami

Our distinct Purpose and our operational expertise across our business processes will help realise our vision – TO BE A HEALTHCARE LEADER AND THE PREEMINENT PROVIDER OF INNOVATIVE NATURAL PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS. WE ARE A COMPANY THAT VALUES THE WELL-BEING OF THE COMMUNITY AND PROMOTES A HEALTHY LIFESTYLE IN A SOCIALLY RESPONSIBLE WAY.

Tujuan kami yang utama dan keahlian operasional kami di seluruh proses bisnis akan membantu mewujudkan visi kami – Menjadi pimpinan di bidang layanan kesehatan dan penyedia terkemuka untuk produk-produk farmasi berbahan alami inovatif. Kami adalah perusahaan yang menghargai kesejahteraan masyarakat dan memperkenalkan gaya hidup yang sehat dengan cara yang bertanggung jawab secara sosial.

## Macro Economic

### 2020 was the worst year in living memory in economic terms

In Indonesia, the economy experienced a contraction in real GDP for the first time since 1998. The GDP in 2020 contracted by 2.1% due largely to the mobility restrictions, especially in Java.

The recession would have been much worse had it not been for the swift action of the government and central bank to put in place the necessary public health policies and financial policies to support particularly those most affected by the recession.

### 2021 has been a recovery year

After plunging into its first recession since the Asian financial crisis, as the GDP contracted by 2.1% from a year earlier, the economy recovered quickly in 2021.

Indonesia's economy has rebounded from the recession as consumers and businesses resumed activities and a global economic recovery boosted exports.

The full year GDP grew at +3.7%. The driver was a combination of improvement in health care and mobility and the sustained global economic recovery, as well as the fiscal stimulus. All indicators are moving to be more positive, providing strong fundamental basis.

## Ekonomi Makro

### 2020 adalah tahun terburuk dalam kehidupan perekonomian di seluruh dunia

Perekonomian Indonesia mengalami kontraksi PDB riil untuk pertama kalinya sejak tahun 1998. PDB tahun 2020 mengalami kontraksi sebesar 2,1% sebagian besar disebabkan oleh pembatasan mobilitas, terutama di Pulau Jawa.

Resesi akan jauh lebih buruk jika bukan karena tindakan cepat dari pemerintah dan bank sentral untuk menerapkan kebijakan kesehatan publik dan kebijakan keuangan yang diperlukan untuk meringankan beban lapisan masyarakat yang paling terkena.

### 2021 adalah tahun pemulihan

Setelah terjun ke dalam resesi untuk pertama kalinya sejak krisis keuangan Asia, karena PDB berkontraksi sebesar 2,1% dari tahun sebelumnya, ekonomi nasional pulih dengan cepat pada tahun 2021.

Perekonomian Indonesia telah pulih dari resesi karena konsumen dan pelaku bisnis melanjutkan aktivitas, dan pemulihan ekonomi global yang telah mendorong ekspor.

PDB sepanjang tahun 2021 tumbuh sebesar +3,7%. Penggeraknya adalah kombinasi dari perbaikan perawatan kesehatan, mobilitas masyarakat, dan pemulihan ekonomi global yang berkelanjutan, serta stimulus fiskal. Semua indikator bergerak menuju ke arah positif, memberikan dasar fundamental yang kuat.

Rising health care costs, changing demographics and evolving health awareness of consumers continue to make self-care more relevant, and are expected to fuel solid long-term growth in the consumer health care market. The Covid-19 pandemic has further raised awareness about the importance of self-care and accelerated growth in categories like health supplements/body defense, as well as the move toward digitalization.

Key strategy in 2022 for Distribution and Logistic business, the biggest business in the Group in terms of sales, is to grow top line, lever fixed costs and expand margins. While Alliance and our strategic ventures will need to continue to achieve aggressive growth and improve profitability.

We believe that long term value creation is the result of both growth and operating efficiency. We achieve sustainable top line growth by investing selectively in high growth categories. To generate efficiency improvements, since 2014, we have made significant efforts to restructure and reshape our business controlling costs and improving long-term competitiveness.

It is our goal to continue to accelerate growth, expand our market footprint and sustain our leadership positions within our specialty areas. We have clearly defined goals, such as sustaining above-market growth in our core businesses. Professional Products and Consumer Health shall contribute significantly to our growth ambition with the main drivers being new product launches and strong base business delivery. We are aiming at achieving sustained organic profitable growth, while targeted acquisitions remain an option.

## Overview

We established our distribution business in 1956 and this gives us a long track record as a successful pharmaceutical and consumer good distribution partner.

As the distribution arm of SOHO Global Health (the "Group"), Parit Padang Global (PPG) distributes both our own products as well as products for over 40 third-party partners ("PPG Principals"). We are distributors for both Indonesian Pharmaceutical & MedTech companies, such as Yarindo, Fahrenheit, Dipa Pharmalab, Global Dispomedika (GDM), Berno, Pharos Indonesia, Kalbe Farma, and International companies, such as Bayer, Johnson & Johnson, BBraun, Eisai, and Novartis. We represent more than two thirds of our PPG portfolio of products on an exclusive basis, which can vary in scope and can range from nation-wide exclusivity to market channel or product exclusivity.

Distribution through PPG is also a key enabler for our Professional Products and Consumer Health businesses. Our extensive distribution network means that any new products that we launch will be available across Indonesia through all of our distribution channels, from hospitals to minimarkets.

Our logistic network provides extensive presence across the entire Indonesian archipelago with coverage of approximately 95% of hospitals and pharmacies in Indonesia, as well as many modern outlets and traditional outlets, through our 25 branches and three sales offices as well as over 25 third-party sub-distributors.

Sebagai kepanjangan tangan distribusi dari SOHO Global Health ("Grup"), PPG mendistribusikan produk-produk milik Grup SGH dan produk untuk lebih dari 40 mitra pihak ketiga ("Prinsipal PPG"). Distribusi melalui PPG juga merupakan pendorong utama pertumbuhan bisnis Produk Profesional dan Kesehatan Konsumen kami. ## 2022 Strategy

The year 2022 will continue to see ongoing expansion of both PPG's direct and in-direct (i.e through the sub-distributor network) coverage.

Process digitization will continue to be a high priority, not just to deliver even more efficient supply chain performance, but also to offer superior service and convenience to our customers.

In brief, PPG future strategies will remain focused on the followings:

- Grow sales, lever fixed costs and expand margins
- Relentlessly manage collection, working capital and delivery costs
- Aggressively pursue addition of new principals to succeed in 2022 and over the next 3 to 5 years regardless of demand environment
- Enhance and grow PPGOS platform

## Strategi 2022

Fokus PPG di tahun 2021 akan terus mengembangkan perluasan jaringan distribusinya baik langsung maupun tidak langsung (melalui jaringan sub-distributor).

Proses digitalisasi akan terus menjadi prioritas, tidak hanya untuk mendukung kinerja supply chain yang lebih efisien, tetapi juga untuk memberikan layanan yang unggul dan kenyamanan bagi pelanggan.

Singkatnya, strategi PPG ke depannya akan tetap fokus pada hal-hal berikut:

- Meningkatkan penjualan, mengoptimalkan biaya tetap, dan meningkatkan marjin
- Mengelola penagihan Piutang Usaha, modal kerja dan biaya pengiriman
- Secara agresif mengupayakan penambahan bisnis baru untuk memastikan kesuksesan pencapaian target tahun 2022 dan target 3 sampai 5 tahun mendatang, terlepas dari kondisi ekonomi yang mungkin belum sepenuhnya pulih
- Meningkatkan pertumbuhan bisnis melalui platform PPGOS

# Change in accounting policy

Our financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards and the Capital Market and Indonesian Financial Services Authority or OJK regulation.

Implementation of new accounting standards

The Group made first time adoption of all the new and/or revised standards effective for the periods beginning on or after January 1, 2021, including the following revised standards that have affected the consolidated financial statements of the Group:

1. Amendments to Statement of Financial Accounting Standards ("PSAK") 22: Definition of a Business

The amendment to PSAK 22 Business Combinations clarifies that to be considered a business, an integrated set of activities and assets must include, at a minimum, an input and a substantive process that, together, significantly contribute to the ability to create output. Furthermore, it clarifies that a business can exist without including all of the inputs and processes needed to create outputs. These amendments had no impact on the consolidated financial statements of the Group, but may impact future periods should the Group enter into any business combinations.

2. Amendments to PSAK 55, PSAK 60, PSAK 62, PSAK 71 and PSAK 73 - Interest Rate Benchmark Reform (Phase 2)

The amendments provide temporary reliefs which address the financial reporting effects when an interbank offered rate (IBOR) is replaced with an alternative nearly risk-free interest rate (RFR). The amendments include the following practical expedients:

- A practical expedient to require contractual changes, or changes to cash flows that are directly required by the (interest rate benchmark) reform, to be treated as changes to a floating interest rate, equivalent to a movement in a market rate of interest.
- Permit changes required by interest rate benchmark reform to be made to hedge designations and hedge documentation without the hedging relationship being discontinued.
- Provide temporary relief to entities from having to meet the separately identifiable requirement when an RFR instrument is designated as a hedge of a risk component.

Penerapan pernyataan standar akuntansi baru

Kelompok Usaha menerapkan pertama kali seluruh standar baru dan/atau yang direvisi yang berlaku efektif untuk periode yang dimulai pada atau setelah 1 Januari 2021, termasuk standar yang direvisi berikut ini yang mempengaruhi laporan keuangan konsolidasian Kelompok Usaha:

1. Amandemen Pernyataan Standar Akuntansi Keuangan ("PSAK") 22: Definisi Bisnis

Amandemen PSAK 22 Kombinasi Bisnis mengklarifikasi bahwa untuk dianggap sebagai suatu bisnis, suatu rangkaian terintegrasi dari aktivitas dan aset harus mencakup minimal, input dan proses substantif yang bersama-sama, berkontribusi secara signifikan terhadap kemampuan menghasilkan output. Selain itu, amandemen ini mengklarifikasi bahwa suatu bisnis tetap ada walaupun tidak mencakup seluruh input dan proses yang diperlukan untuk menghasilkan output. Amandemen ini tidak berdampak pada laporan keuangan konsolidasian Kelompok Usaha, tetapi dapat berdampak pada periode-periode mendatang jika Kelompok Usaha melakukan kombinasi bisnis.

2. Amandemen PSAK 55, PSAK 60, PSAK 62, PSAK 71 dan PSAK 73 - Reformasi Acuan Suku Bunga (Tahap 2)

Amandemen-amandemen ini memberikan kelonggaran sementara terkait dengan dampak pelaporan keuangan ketika suku bunga penawaran antarbank (Interbank Offered Rate) diganti dengan acuan suku bunga alternatif yang hampir bebas risiko (SBB). Amandemen tersebut mencakup cara praktis sebagai berikut ini:

- Cara praktis yang mensyaratkan perubahan kontraktual, atau perubahan arus kas yang secara langsung sebagaimana disyaratkan oleh reformasi (suku bunga acuan), untuk diperlakukan sebagai perubahan suku bunga mengambang, yang setara dengan pergerakan suku bunga pasar.
- Mengizinkan perubahan yang disyaratkan oleh reformasi suku bunga acuan terhadap penetapan dan dokumentasi lindung nilai tanpa penghentian hubungan lindung nilai.
- Memberikan kelonggaran sementara kepada entitas untuk memenuhi ketentuan dapat diidentifikasi secara terpisah, pada saat instrumen SBB ditetapkan sebagai lindung nilai dari suatu komponen risiko.

Annual Report

These amendments had no impact on the consolidated financial statements of the Group. The Group intends to use the practical expedients in future periods if they become applicable.

3. Amendments to PSAK 73: Leases - Covid-19 Related Rent Concessions After June 30, 2021

In light of the ongoing pandemic additional amendment was subsequently issued in March 2021 to extend the scope of the lease concession period, which is one of the conditions for applying the practical expedient, from June 30, 2021 in Covid-19 Related Rent Concessions - Amendments to PSAK 73: Leases issued in May 2020, to June 30, 2022.

If a lessee already applied the practical expedient in the May 2020 amendment, it is required to continue to apply the practical expedient consistently, to all lease contracts with similar characteristics and in similar circumstances, using the March 2021 amendment. If a lessee did not apply the practical expedient in the May 2020 amendment to eligible lease concessions, it is prohibited from applying the practical expedient in the March 2021 amendment.

Amandemen ini tidak berdampak pada laporan keuangan konsolidasian Kelompok Usaha. Kelompok Usaha bermaksud untuk menggunakan cara praktis di periode-periode mendatang jika dapat diterapkan.

3. Amandemen PSAK 73: Sewa - Konsesi Sewa Terkait Covid-19 Setelah 30 Juni 2021

Sehubungan dengan pandemi yang terus berlangsung, amandemen tambahan diterbitkan pada bulan Maret 2021 dimana memperpanjang cakupan periode konsesi sewa, yang merupakan salah satu syarat penerapan cara praktis, dari tanggal 30 Juni 2021 dalam amandemen PSAK 73 Sewa tentang Konsesi Sewa terkait Covid-19 yang diterbitkan di bulan Mei 2020, menjadi 30 Juni 2022.

Jika penyewa telah menerapkan cara praktis dalam amandemen di bulan Mei 2020, maka diharuskan untuk terus menerapkannya secara konsisten, untuk semua kontrak sewa dengan karakteristik serupa dan dalam keadaan serupa, menggunakan amandemen tersebut. # Commitment to Good Corporate Governance Practices

The Company is committed to operate at the highest standards of Good Corporate Governance. We want to ensure that everything our employees do is guided by our commitment to our values and is in compliance with the local laws and regulations. The foundations of these commitments are laid out in our Good Corporate Governance ("GCG") Code, which we established in October 2015 and has become the underpinning set of rules for management and employees. The GCG Code collects a number of key principles and provides a working guideline for the way in which we apply our values across our operations. GCG practices are extremely important to the Company's ability to accomplish its goals.

The corporate governance (GCG) implementation has been carried out in accordance with the applicable laws and Company regulations. Each governance body functions independently and responsibly. Besides that, every decision taken has considered the GCG principles related to transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, as well as equality and fairness.

These five principles of GCG help the Company maintain a harmonious and ethical relationship with its shareholders and other stakeholders.

In addition, the implementation of GCG principles in business activities is also supporting integrity, work ethics, and accountable decision-making through supervision, control activities and adequate risk management.

Based on this understanding, GCG becomes the reference for the Company to deal with the increasing competition and the uncertainties in business, while ensuring its long-term business continuity.

To enhance the implementation quality, the Company conducts evaluation and follow up for the implementation of GCG across its entire portfolio of businesses.

Perseroan berkomitmen untuk beroperasi dengan standar tertinggi dari Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik. Kami ingin memastikan bahwa semua yang dilakukan karyawan kami dipimpin oleh komitmen kami terhadap nilai-nilai kami dan sesuai dengan hukum dan peraturan setempat. Dasar dari komitmen ini dituangkan dalam Kode Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik ("GCG"), yang kami tetapkan pada bulan Oktober 2015 dan telah menjadi perangkat peraturan yang mendasari bagi manajemen dan karyawan. Kode GCG berisi sejumlah prinsip utama dan memberikan pedoman kerja tentang cara kami menerapkan nilai-nilai kami di seluruh operasi Perseroan. Praktik GCG sangat penting bagi kemampuan Perseroan untuk mencapai tujuannya.

Penerapan tata kelola perusahaan (GCG) di Perseroan telah berjalan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan dan peraturan yang berlaku di Perseroan. Setiap organ tata kelola menjalankan fungsi secara independen dan bertanggung jawab. Di samping itu, setiap keputusan yang diambil telah memperhatikan prinsip-prinsip GCG terkait transparansi, akuntabilitas, responsibilitas, independensi, serta kesetaraan dan kewajaran.

Kelima asas GCG tersebut membantu Perseroan dalam menjaga hubungan harmonis yang sesuai etika dengan pemegang saham dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

Selain itu, implementasi asas GCG dalam aktivitas usaha juga mendukung integritas, etika kerja dan pengambilan keputusan yang bertanggung jawab melalui kegiatan pengawasan, pengendalian, dan pengelolaan risiko yang layak.

Berdasarkan pemahaman tersebut, GCG menjadi rujukan Perseroan untuk menghadapi ketatnya persaingan dan tidak menentunya iklim investasi di dunia usaha, serta menjaga kelangsungan usaha jangka panjang.

Untuk meningkatkan kualitas implementasinya, Perseroan senantiasa melakukan evaluasi dan tindak lanjut perbaikan terhadap penerapan GCG di seluruh lini usaha yang dijalankan.

# Good Corporate Governance Mechanism

The GCG mechanism at the Company stipulates the relationships between the Company's governance bodies, namely the GMS, the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and other supporting bodies.

The GMS has an exclusive authority that cannot be delegated to other bodies, in accordance with the Limited Liability Company Law and/or Articles of Association. Meanwhile, the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors are responsible for the supervision and management of the company to maintain the sustainability of Company's business.

The implementation of the tasks and responsibilities of the two bodies are supported by their respective supporting bodies. The Board of Commissioners is assisted by the Audit Committee, and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

While the Board of Directors is assisted by the Corporate Secretary and Internal Audit Unit.

The Company always complies with the applicable laws and regulations, including its preparation of Financial Statements that involves external auditors (public accounting firm or KAP). The appointment of KAP is carried out by considering aspects of independence in terms of personnel, processes, and audit results so that the Company's Financial Statements meet the principles of transparency and accountability

# Mekanisme Tata Kelola Perusahaan

Mekanisme GCG di Perseroan mengatur pola hubungan antara organ perusahaan yang terdiri dari RUPS, Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan organ pendukung lainnya.

RUPS menjadi organ perusahaan dengan kewenangan eksklusif yang tidak dapat dilimpahkan kepada organ lain, selama masih sesuai dengan Undang-Undang Perseroan Terbatas dan/atau Anggaran Dasar. Sementara itu, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi masing-masing bertanggung jawab dalam pengawasan dan pengelolaan perusahaan untuk memelihara keberlanjutan usaha Perseroan.

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab kedua organ tersebut didukung oleh organ pendukung masing-masing. Dewan Komisaris dibantu oleh Komite Audit dan Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi.

Sedangkan Direksi dibantu oleh Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Unit Audit Internal.

Perseroan senantiasa memenuhi kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, termasuk menyusun Laporan Keuangan yang melibatkan audit eksternal (kantor akuntan publik/KAP). Penunjukan KAP dilaksanakan dengan memperhatikan aspek independensi dari sisi personil, proses, dan hasil audit sehingga Laporan Keuangan Perseroan memenuhi prinsip transparansi dan akuntabilitas.

# General Meeting of Shareholders

Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham

The General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) is the main mechanism to protect and exercise the rights of shareholders. As an organ of the Company, GMS holds the supreme power within the Company and possesses all authorities which cannot be delegated to the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors. Without diluting either the power or authority of the GMS, the GMS or shareholders may not intervene against the duties, functions, and authorities of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors, in carrying out their obligations and rights in accordance with the Articles of Association and prevailing laws and regulations.

The GMS serves as a mechanism for shareholders to make important decisions regarding their investment in the Company, by observing provisions in the Articles of Association and all prevailing regulations.

## Board of Commissioners Charter

In supervising the Company's management, the Board of Commissioners follows the guideline from Board of Commissioners Charter which contains their duties, responsibilities, and authorities.

## Assessment of the performance of the Board of Commissioners

Referring to the Board of Commissioners Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Commissioners is carried out by the Company's shareholders. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Approvaisal of the Board of Commissioners, in which this policy is prepared as a guideline that can be used to assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners and also as a form of accountability for the assessment of the performance of the Board of Commissioners of the Company.

The Company's shareholders periodically evaluate the performance of the Board of Commissioners at least once a year. Performance appraisal is carried out on the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners in supervising and managing the Company as stated in the laws and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association.

## Piagam Dewan Komisaris

Dalam mengawasi pengelolaan Perseroan, Dewan Komisaris berpedoman pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris yang memuat tugas, tanggung jawab dan wewenang Dewan Komisaris.

## Penilaian terhadap kinerja Dewan Komisaris

Mengacu pada Piagam Dewan Komisaris (Board of Commissioners Charter), penilaian atas kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, yang mana kebijakan tersebut disusun sebagai pedoman yang dapat digunakan untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris Perseroan.

Pemegang saham Perseroan secara berkala melakukan evaluasi atas kinerja Dewan Komisaris setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun. Penilaian kinerja dilakukan terhadap pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris dalam mengawasi dan mengelola Perseroan sebagaimana yang tercantum dalam peraturan perundang-undangan dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

Di samping itu, berdasarkan Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris yang berlaku di Perseroan, maka di bawah ini merupakan ketentuan atas penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris:

1) Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is performed using self-assessment every year collegially.
2) Performance appraisal of each member of the Board of Commissioners is performed by the President Commissioner every year based on role and responsibilities of the Board of Commissioners.
3) The Board of Commissioners conducting self-assessment, then the results are consolidated to be reviewed by the Board of Commissioners in order to determine the board effectiveness and the areas for improvements.
4) The Board of Commissioners prepares the corrective actions, and the President Commissioner ensures the implementation of the corrective actions.
5) Performance appraisal of the Board of Commissioners is conducted by considering several components, which include structure and composition of the Board of Commissioners, strategy implementation and company management, the effectiveness of the committee, risk management implementation and internal control, and the implementation of Good Corporate Governance.

The Policy on Performance Appraisal of the Board of Commissioners also regulates the aspects of the Board of Commissioners' assessment. These aspects are, among others:

1. Supervise the management of the Company performed by the Board of Directors
2. Review, examine, and approve the annual work plan of the Company
3. Perform special duties assigned to him/her pursuant to the Articles of Association, the prevailing laws and regulations and/or the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders
4. Perform his/her duties and responsibilities pursuant to the provisions of the Articles of Association and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders
5. Comply with the Articles of the Association and the prevailing laws and regulations and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility and fairness, among others to convey the BOC meeting in accordance with the applicable regulations.

1) Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan metode self-assessment setiap tahun secara kolonial.
2) Penilaian kinerja Anggota Dewan Komisaris dilakukan oleh Komisaris Utama setiap tahun berdasarkan tugas dan tanggung jawab Dewan Komisaris.
3) Anggota Dewan Komisaris melakukan self-assessment, kemudian hasilnya dikonsolidasi untuk ditinjau oleh Dewan Komisaris guna menetapkan efektivitas dari Dewan beserta area-area yang perlu dilakukan perbaikan.
4) Dewan Komisaris menyusun rencana tindak lanjut perbaikan dan Komisaris Utama memastikan pelaksanaan rencana perbaikan tersebut.
5) Penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilakukan dengan mempertimbangkan beberapa komponen, antara lain: struktur dan komposisi Dewan Komisaris, pelaksanaan strategi dan pengelolaan perusahaan, efektivitas pelaksanaan program kerja komite, penerapan manajemen risiko dan pengendalian internal, serta penerapan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik.

Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Dewan Komisaris juga mengatur perihal aspek-aspek penilaian Dewan Komisaris. Aspek-aspek yang dimaksud antara lain:

1. Mengawasi pengurusan Perseroan yang dilaksanakan oleh Direksi

4. Melakukan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya sesuai dengan ketentuan-ketentuan Anggaran Dasar dan keputusan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham

## Board of Directors Charter

In managing the Company, the Board of Directors follows the guideline from Board of Directors Charter which contains their duties, responsibilities, and authorities.

## Assessment of the performance of the Board of Directors

Referring to the Board of Directors Charter, the evaluation of the performance of the members of the Board of Directors is carried out by the Board Of Commissioners and shareholders of the Company. The Company also has a Policy on Performance Assessment of the Board of Directors, in which this policy is prepared as a guideline that can be used to assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the duties and responsibilities of the Board of Directors and also as a form of accountability for the performance assessment of the Board of Directors of the Company.

The Board of Directors Charter contains an explanation of the method for evaluating the performance of members of the Board of Directors, which include the following:

## Piagam Direksi

Dalam mengelola Perseroan, Direksi berpedoman pada Piagam Direksi yang memuat tugas, tanggung jawab, dan wewenang Direksi.

## Penilaian terhadap kinerja Direksi

Mengacu pada Piagam Direksi (Board of Directors Charter), penilaian atas kinerja anggota Direksi dilakukan oleh Dewan Komisaris dan pemegang saham Perseroan. Perseroan juga telah memiliki Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi, yang mana kebijakan ini disusun sebagai pedoman yang dapat digunakan untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Direksi dan juga sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas atas penilaian kinerja Direksi Perseroan.

Piagam Direksi (Board of Directors Charter) memuat penjelasan mengenai metode evaluasi/penilaian kinerja atas anggota Direksi, yang mana di antaranya adalah sebagai berkut:

1. The Board of Commissioners will determine the Key Performance Indicators (KPI);
2. The Board of Commissioners will evaluate the performance achievements of the members of the Board of Directors which will then be submitted to the shareholders at the General Meeting of Shareholders ("GMS");
3. The performance evaluation of the members of the Board of Directors will be carried out based on the following KPIs:
- Achievement of the Board of Directors' performance (collectively) by looking at the Company's achievements based on the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, and/or other criteria determined by the Board of Commissioners.
- Achievement of the performance of the Board of Directors (individually) in achieving the Company's performance as stated in the Business Plan and Annual Operational Plan, Management Contract, and or other criteria determined in the Board of Commissioners meeting.
- Implementation of Good Corporate Governance principles, both individually and collectively.

In addition, the Board of Directors performance appraisal is also stipulated in the Board of Directors Performance Assessment Policy, namely:
1) All members of the Board of Directors have performance goals based on the duties and responsibilities of each member.
2) Performance appraisal of the Board of Directors is conducted every year by the President Director.
3) Performance appraisal results of the Board of Directors is reported to the Board of Commissioner through the Nomination Committee.

The Board of Directors' Performance Assessment Policy also regulates the aspects of the Board of Directors' assessment. These aspects include:
1. Lead, manage, and control the Company in accordance with the purpose of the Company.
2. Make effort to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the Company.
3. Prepare an annual work plan containing the annual budget of the Company and submit the plan to the Board of Commissioner to obtain approval before the beginning of the following fiscal year.
4. Perform his/her duties and responsibilities pursuant to the provisions of the Articles and the resolutions of the General Meeting of Shareholders.
5. Comply with the Articles of Association and the prevailing laws and regulations, and be obliged to perform duties based on principles of professionalism, efficiency, transparency, independency, accountability, responsibility and fairness, i.e. to convey the meeting of the Board of Directors in accordance with the applicable regulations.

1. Dewan Komisaris akan menetapkan Indikator Kinerja Utama/ Key Performance Indicator (KPI);
2. Dewan Komisaris akan melakukan evaluasi atas pencapaian kinerja dari anggota Direksi yang mana selanjutnya akan disampaikan pada pemegang saham dalam Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham ("RUPS");
3. Evaluasi kinerja anggota Direksi tersebut akan dilakukan berdasarkan KPI sebagai berikut:
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara bersama-sama) dengan melihat pencapaian Perseroan berdasarkan Rencana Bisnis dan Rencana Operasional Tahunan, dan/atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan oleh Dewan Komisaris.
- Pencapaian kinerja Direksi (secara individu) dalam mencapai kinerja Perusahaan Perseroan sebagaimana tercantum dalam Rencana Bisnis dan, Rencana Operasional Tahunan, Kontrak Manajemen, dan atau kriteria lainnya yang ditetapkan dalam rapat Dewan Komisaris.
- Implementasi prinsip-prinsip Tata Kelola yang Baik (Good Corporate Governance), baik secara individu maupun kolektif

Di samping itu, penilaian kinerja Direksi juga ditetapkan di dalam Kebijakan Penilaian atas Kinerja Direksi, yakni:
1) Seluruh anggota Direksi memiliki target kinerja sesuai dengan tugas dan tanggung jawab masing-masing.
2) Penilaian kinerja anggota Direksi dilakukan setiap tahun oleh Direktur Utama.
3) Hasil penilaian kinerja anggota Direksi diberikan kepada Dewan Komisaris melalui Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi.

# Whistleblowing System

Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran

## Whistleblowing System

In 2014, a whistleblowing system policy was issued in line with the Company's core value of absolute integrity. This policy led to the establishment of a whistleblowing hotline which is clear and easily accessible by all Company employees, where suspected and actual violation of the Code of Business Ethics and Conduct may be reported.

All employees are encouraged to report any suspected or actual violations noted. Reports can be made thru:

- Compliance hotline
- E-mail

All whistleblower identities are kept with utmost confidentiality. Further, the Company also provides protection from retaliation, threats and intimidation for the whistleblowers.

## Reporting Scope

Matters covered by the policy includes allegations related to:

- Violation of the Code of Business Ethics and Conduct
- Violation of the law
- Bribery and/or corruption
- Conflict of interest
- Fraudulent acts
- Other similar violation that will equate to the above

## Handling of Reported Violations

Reported cases are received by the compliance officer. The information analyzed and investigated for evidence gathering. Selected members of the Internal Audit Unit is requested to assist, as necessary.

The case report is then presented to the Ethics Committee for review and sanction recommendation, before being presented to the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners for final approval.

## Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran

Pada tahun 2014 telah dikeluarkan kebijakan sistem whistleblowing yang sejalan dengan nilai inti integritas mutlak Perseroan. Kebijakan ini mengarah pada pembentukan hotline whistleblowing yang jelas dan mudah diakses oleh semua karyawan Perseroan, dimana dugaan dan pelanggaran nyata terhadap Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis dapat dilaporkan.

Semua karyawan didorong untuk melaporkan setiap dugaan atau pelanggaran aktual yang dicatat. Laporan dapat dilakukan melalui:

- Hotline kepatuhan
- E-mail

Semua identitas pelapor disimpan dengan sangat rahasia. Selanjutnya, Perseroan juga memberikan perlindungan dari pembalasan, ancaman dan intimidasi bagi pelapor.

## Ruang Lingkup Pelaporan

Hal-hal yang tercakup dalam kebijakan tersebut mencakup dugaan terkait dengan:

- Pelanggaran Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis
- Pelanggaran hukum
- Penyuapan dan/atau korupsi
- Konflik kepentingan
- Tindakan penipuan
- Pelanggaran serupa lainnya yang akan disamakan dengan yang ada di atas

## Penanganan Pelanggaran Yang Dilaporkan

Kasus yang dilaporkan diterima oleh petugas kepatuhan. Informasi dianalisis dan diselidiki untuk pengumpulan bukti. Anggota terpilih dari Unit Internal Audit diminta untuk membantu, jika diperlukan.

Risk Management

Manajemen Risiko

In supervising and managing material business risks, the Company had established Standard Operating Procedure Number SOP 8-02-02/R03 dated November 15 2021 regarding Risk Management which serves as guidance on how the Company can effectively conduct its process of identifying, analyzing, evaluating, treating, monitoring and reviewing risks.

In addition, the SOP for Risk Management also aims to ensure that management and all employees have the same perception and understanding of the concept of risk management and raise awareness of the importance of risk management.

In general, below describes the risk management process in the Company's environment:

Dalam melakukan pengawasan dan pengelolaan risiko bisnis yang material, Perseroan telah menetapkan Standard Operating Procedure Nomor SOP 8-02-02/R03 tanggal 15 November 2021 tentang Manajemen Risiko yang menjadi pedoman bagaimana Perseroan dapat secara efektif melakukan proses identifikasi, analisis, evaluasi, perlakuan, pemantauan, dan peninjauan risiko.

Selain itu, SOP Manajemen Risiko tersebut juga bertujuan untuk memastikan bahwa manajemen dan seluruh pegawai memiliki persepsi serta pemahaman yang sama mengenai konsep manajemen risiko dan menumbuhkan kesadaran mengenai pentingnya manajemen risiko.

Secara umum, di bawah ini menggambarkan proses manajemen risiko di lingkungan Perseroan:

![img-118.jpeg](img-118.jpeg)

Responsibility for implementation of risk assessment is with each Company working unit (Department/Division). The assessment is documented in a Risk Assessment Form which will serve as the risk register for such working unit. The risk assessment is conducted continuously by the working unit and tested and reviewed by the Internal Audit Division at least annually.

The Company's risk register and profile is reported and reviewed by the Company's Management annually or as significant changes transpire.

## Types of Risk and Management Method

The following are the types of risks used by the Company as a benchmark for conducting risk analysis, including:

a. Operational Risk:
Risks that arise due to insufficient and / or failure of internal processes, human error, system failure, or external problems affecting business activities such as force majeure, natural disasters, fires and others.

b. Compliance Risk:
Risks caused by the Company not complying with or not implementing statutory regulations and other applicable provisions.

c. Strategic Risk
Risks arise due to improper strategic determination and implementation, inappropriate decision making, or the Company's lack of responsiveness to external changes.

d. Reputation Risk
Risks that arise due to negative publicity on operational activities or negative perceptions of the Company.

A risk evaluation which is conducted where the probability and the severity level of the identified risk is analyzed and estimated.

The risk evaluation shows the result of what risks should be prioritized for further action.

Follow-up from the results of the risk evaluation will be validated where the results of the validation will be used to establish a control system/process to reduce the likelihood of risk occurring and to reduce the impact of the risk.

It is necessary to have a mitigation / risk treatment for the necessary control plans to be made.

The risk scores are mandatory to be mitigated are medium (medium) and high (high). Risk mitigation measures include identifying options for dealing with risks, assessing those options, preparing a risk treatment plan, and implementing a risk treatment plan.

Tanggung jawab pelaksanaan penilaian risiko berada pada masing-masing unit kerja Perseroan (Departemen/Divisi). Penilaian tersebut didokumentasikan dalam Risk Assessment Form yang akan berfungsi sebagai daftar risiko untuk unit kerja tersebut. Penilaian risiko dilakukan secara berkelanjutan oleh unit kerja dan diuji serta direview oleh Divisi Internal Audit minimal setiap tahun.

Daftar dan profil risiko Perseroan dilaporkan dan ditinjau oleh Manajemen Perseroan setiap tahun atau jika terjadi perubahan signifikan.

## Jenis Risiko Dan Cara Pengelolaannya

Berikut merupakan jenis-jenis risiko yang digunakan oleh Perseroan sebagai tolak ukur untuk melakukan analisa resiko, antara lain:

a. Risiko Operasional:
Risiko yang ditimbulkan karena ketidakcukupan dan atau kegagalan proses internal, kesalahan manusia, kegagalan sistem, atau adanya masalah eksternal yang mempengaruhi kegiatan usaha seperti force majeure, bencana alam, kebakaran dan lain-lain.

b. Risiko Kepatuhan:
Risiko yang disebabkan Perseroan tidak mematuhi atau tidak melaksanakan regulasi perundang-undangan dan ketentuan lain yang berlaku.

c. Risiko Strategis:
Risiko timbul karena penetapan dan pelaksanaan strategis yang tidak tepat, pengambilan keputusan yang tidak tepat, atau kurang responsifnya Perseroan terhadap perubahan eksternal.

d. Risiko Reputasi:
Risiko yang timbul karena publikasi negatif terhadap kegiatan operasional atau persepsi negatif terhadap Perseroan.

Evaluasi risiko yang dilakukan dimana probabilitas dan tingkat keparahan risiko yang teridentifikasi dianalisa dan diperkirakan.

Evaluasi risiko menunjukkan hasil risiko apa saja yang harus diprioritaskan untuk tindakan lebih lanjut.

Tindak lanjut dari hasil evaluasi risiko akan divalidasi dimana hasil validasi tersebut akan digunakan untuk menetapkan rencana langkah-langkah sistem/proses pengendalian untuk menurunkan kemungkinan terjadinya risiko dan untuk menurunkan dampak dari risiko tersebut.

Perlu adanya suatu mitigasi/perlakuan risiko untuk rencana pengendalian yang perlu dibuat.

Nilai risiko yang wajib dilakukan mitigasi adalah sedang (medium) dan tinggi (high). Langkah mitigasi risiko meliputi pengidentifikasi opsi untuk menangani risiko, menilai opsi tersebut, menyiapkan rencana perlakuan risiko, dan mengimplementasikan rencana perlakuan risiko.

# Public Accountant

Akuntan Publik

Public accountant is an external party supporting the Company in evaluating or auditing the Annual Report in accordance with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards. The appointment of a public accountant is expected to help Company provide accountable, independent, and fair information and data to Shareholders, regulator, as well as other stakeholders.

## External Audit Procedures and Audit Standards

The audit on the Company's Financial Statement is implemented in accordance with the public accountant's professional standards, covering all audit procedures regarded compatible with the Company's condition. The audit processes are testing, verifying, and evaluating the Financial Statements, as well as assessing the compliance of its contents with the Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards.

As a part of the audit processes, the Public Accounting Firm (KAP) performs an interview to obtain the management's statement to be presented in the Financial Statements. Should there be errors found in the Financial Statements, the KAP must convey them to the Management of the Company. The management is also responsible for approving the KAP's audit worksheets.

## 2021 Public Accountant

Based on the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on May 3, 2021, the Company appointed Purwantono Sungkoro & Surja (Ernst & Young) Public Accounting Firm to perform audit on the Consolidated Financial Statements of the Company for the 2021 Financial Year. Management of the Company guarantees that the appointed KAP had no conflict of interest with the Company.

The appointed public accountant only performed general audit on the Consolidated Financial Statements of the Company for the 2021 Financial Year. The report is presented accurately and fairly. Akuntan publik merupakan organ eksternal yang membantu Perseroan dalam melakukan pemeriksaan atau mengaudit Laporan Keuangan agar sesuai dengan Standar Akuntasi Keuangan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Penunjukan akuntan publik ini diharapkan dapat mendorong Perusahaan untuk memberikan informasi dan data yang akuntabel, independen, dan wajar kepada Pemegang Saham, regulator, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya.

## Prosedur Audit Eksternal dan Standar Audit

Audit Laporan Keuangan Perseroan dilakukan sesuai standar profesional akuntan publik, mencakup seluruh prosedur audit yang dianggap sesuai dengan keadaan perusahaan. Audit yang dilakukan meliputi pengujian, pemeriksaan, dan evaluasi terhadap Laporan Keuangan, serta penilaian terhadap kesesuaian isi Laporan Keuangan dengan standar akuntansi keuangan (PSAK).

Sebagai bagian dari proses audit, kantor akuntan publik (KAP) melakukan sesi tanya jawab mengenai pernyataan manajemen yang disampaikan dalam Laporan Keuangan. Jika terjadi kekeliruan di dalam laporan tersebut, maka KAP wajib menyampaikannya kepada manajemen Perseroan. Manajemen juga bertanggung jawab untuk menyetujui kertas kerja pemeriksa KAP terhadap Perseroan.

# Explanation of the Sustainability Report

Penjelasan Strategi Berkelanjutan

## Sustainability Strategy

Recognising that our world binds us together in a dynamic, complex network of relationships. We know the health of people (including our workforce and society at large), the planet and our business are interconnected. The scale and severity of the issues we face today require us to assess all options simultaneously. We look for opportunities that offer synergies and address systemic issues.

Acknowledging there are no quick fixes; anticipating and designing out unintended impacts; observing how impacts change over time; building resilience. We differentiate between addressing our negative environmental impacts and creating the conditions for deep, lasting sustainability.

Our sustainability strategy is guided by a materiality assessment. This robust process determines the topics that are most important to Soho Global Health and our stakeholders, giving us the opportunity to achieve the most positive impact. We have three main interconnected priorities:

### Access to healthcare

We are working towards a future where people have access to sustainable healthcare solutions. We aim to do this by continuously innovating and evolving our products and ways of working to address the current and future needs of our stakeholders.

### Environmental

We are setting targets to mitigate our direct impacts to the environment. We are also gaining transparency in reporting our emissions and having an enterprise-wide governance and executive-level of involvement. We are also engaging 3rd party assurance review to assess our sustainability performance.

### Ethics and Transparency

We have established a Code of Business Ethics and Conduct which serves as our moral compass. We know that setting rules is not enough, which is why we emphasize values-based decision making. We encourage our workforce to adopt a sustainability mindset that embraces our Core Values.

## Strategi Keberlanjutan

Menyadari bahwa dunia kita mengikat kita bersama dalam jaringan hubungan yang dinamis dan kompleks. Kita tahu kesehatan orang (termasuk tenaga kerja kita dan masyarakat pada umumnya), dunia dan bisnis kita saling berhubungan. Skala dan keparahan masalah yang kita hadapi saat ini mengharuskan kita untuk menilai semua opsi secara bersamaan. Kami mencari peluang yang menawarkan sinergi dan mengatasi masalah sistemik.

Mengakui tidak ada perbaikan cepat; mengantisipasi dan merancang dampak yang tidak diinginkan; mengamati bagaimana dampak berubah dari waktu ke waktu; membangun ketahanan. Kami membedakan antara mengatasi dampak lingkungan negatif kami dan menciptakan kondisi untuk keberlanjutan yang dalam dan langgeng.

Strategi keberlanjutan kami dipandu oleh penilaian materialitas. Proses yang kuat ini menentukan topik yang paling penting untuk Soho Global Health dan pemangku kepentingan kami, memberi kami kesempatan untuk mencapai dampak paling positif. Kami memiliki tiga prioritas utama yang saling berhubungan:

### Akses ke layanan kesehatan

Kami bekerja menuju masa depan di mana orang memiliki akses ke solusi perawatan kesehatan yang berkelanjutan. Kami bertujuan untuk melakukan ini dengan terus berinovasi dan mengembangkan produk dan cara kerja kami untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pemangku kepentingan kami saat ini dan di masa depan.

### Lingkungan

Kami menetapkan target untuk mengurangi dampak langsung kami terhadap lingkungan. Kami juga mendapatkan transparansi dalam melaporkan emisi kami dan memiliki tata kelola perusahaan dan keterlibatan tingkat eksekutif. Kami juga melakukan tinjauan jaminan pihak ketiga untuk menilai kinerja keberlanjutan kami.

### Etika dan Transparansi

Kami telah menetapkan Kode Etik dan Perilaku Bisnis yang berfungsi sebagai kompas moral kami. Kami tahu bahwa menetapkan aturan saja tidak cukup, oleh karena itu kami menekankan pengambilan keputusan berbasis nilai. Kami mendorong tenaga kerja kami untuk mengadopsi pola pikir keberlanjutan yang merangkul Nilai-nilai Utama kami.

# Overview of Sustainability
Aspects

Gambaran Umum Aspek Keberlanjutan (Sosial dan Lingkungan)

## Environment Friendly Innovation

We implement green technology in carrying out our business processes. The application of green technology applied includes maximizing the use of extracted waste to become compost which is used in the curcuma garden at the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) as organic fertilizer, SCHER is certified as organic practitioner by the Indonesian Organic Farming Certification.

We also started shifting the use of organic solvents to water-based solvents for product coating. Further, we reduced the aluminium foil content of some of our packaging materials, this did not significantly impact the quality of the packaging.

## Partnership with Local Stakeholders

SOHO Global Health is committed to contributing to the socio-economic aspects of farmers and communities. We collaborate with communities around the SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) in this case with the Dahlia Women Farmers Group. We are also committed to increasing farmers' income, one of which is the implementation of Smart Farming 4.0 which was initiated in 2020 and has been applied to all planted areas in the 2021 planting year. The implementation of Smart Farming 4.0 is able to have an impact on increasing the yield of curcuma, from 1,798 kg in 2020 it will be 1,897 kg in 2021. The increase in crop yields also provides an increase in farmers' income by 5.51% in 2021. We also encourage farmers to apply intercropping with sweet corn plants to help the farmers' have more income from crops. In 2017, we also conducted research related to the cultivation of intercropping during the curcuma cultivation process, where the method of intercropping with sweet corn did not affect the quality of the curcuma produced. In fact intercropping was able to provide a positive impact for farmers, repeated land cultivation enriches the soil that it gives a positive impact on curcuma cultivation.

## Inovasi Ramah Lingkungan

Kami menerapkan teknologi hijau dalam menjalankan proses bisnis kami. Penerapan teknologi hijau yang diterapkan antara lain memaksimalkan pemanfaatan limbah hasil ekstraksi menjadi kompos yang digunakan di kebun temulawak di SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) sebagai pupuk organik, SCHER bersertifikat praktisi organik oleh Sertifikasi Pertanian Organik Indonesia.

Kami juga mulai mengalihkan penggunaan pelarut organik ke pelarut berbasis air untuk pelapisan produk. Selanjutnya, kami mengurangi kandungan aluminium foil dari beberapa bahan kemasan kami, hal ini tidak berdampak signifikan terhadap kualitas kemasan.

## Kemitraan dengan Pemangku Kepentingan Lokal

SOHO Global Health berkomitmen untuk berkontribusi pada aspek sosial ekonomi petani dan masyarakat. Kami bekerja sama dengan masyarakat sekitar SOHO Center of Excellence in Herbal Research (SCEHR) dalam hal ini dengan Kelompok Wanita Tani Dahlia. Kami juga berkomitmen untuk meningkatkan pendapatan petani, salah satunya dengan implementasi Smart Farming 4.0 yang telah dirintis pada tahun 2020 dan telah diterapkan di seluruh area tanam pada tahun tanam 2021. Penerapan Smart Farming 4.0 mampu berdampak pada peningkatan hasil panen temulawak, dari 1.798 kg pada tahun 2020 menjadi 1.897 kg pada tahun 2021. Peningkatan hasil panen juga memberikan peningkatan pendapatan petani sebesar 5,51% pada tahun 2021. Kami juga mendorong petani untuk menerapkan tumpang sari dengan tanaman jagung manis untuk membantu petani mendapatkan lebih banyak pendapatan dari tanaman. Pada tahun 2017, kami juga melakukan penelitian terkait budi daya tumpang sari selama proses budi daya temulawak, dimana metode tumpang sari dengan jagung manis tidak mempengaruhi kualitas temulawak yang dihasilkan. Bahkan tumpang sari tidak hanya mampu memberikan dampak positif bagi petani, penggarapan lahan secara berulang mampu menyuburkan tanah sehingga juga dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi budidaya temulawak.

# Energy Use in Distribution and Logistics Activities

PT Parit Padang Global (PPG) is part of the Soho Global Health Group and is engaged in distribution and logistics through branches spread throughout Indonesia. Product distribution from factories or regional distribution center to branches is carried out in collaboration with vendor partners who provide transportation/forwarding services. To distribute products to customers (pharmacies/outlets/health facilities), PPG engages transporter that have passed all emission tests in accordance with the corresponding fuel type. For distribution, logistics, and operational activities in two regional distribution head offices, branches, and outlets, indirect energy is used in the form of electricity. If there are electricity blackouts, PPG use electric generators for backup.

## Efficiency Strategies

a) Electricity - Optimizing and improving the production process thereby minimizing overtime.
b) Water - Monitoring usage and leaks in pipelines and storage tank.
c) Gas - Efficiently using the steam boilers.

## Some of the initiatives that have been performed:

- Replacement of chiller pipe insulation to minimize loss of cooling energy generated from the chiller generator. By replacing the chiller insulation, we can minimize cooling leaks in the chiller water distribution line thereby reducing energy consumption.
- Chiller unit replacement and scaling of production engine cooling lines to maximize engine work processes. With chiller unit replacement and scaling of the cooling line, the production process becomes faster, thereby reducing energy usage.
- Replace lamps with LED type in as this type is more energy efficient
- Replacement of underground water tank from the old building by a water tower, so that leaks will be easily spotted. This reduces loss of water due to leakage of underground reservoir.
